name: Dumbbell bench press
cues: Shoulder blades pinched and down
Lower the dumbbells beside your mid chest
Press up and slightly together over your shoulders
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows

name: Incline dumbbell press
cues: Set the bench to a low to medium incline
Lower to your upper chest with elbows about 45 degrees from your body
Press up without bouncing
Keep your feet planted

name: Decline dumbbell press
cues: Lock your legs in and lie back on the decline bench
Lower the dumbbells beside your lower chest
Press up over your chest
Keep the dumbbells controlled when you set them down

name: Dumbbell floor press
cues: Lie on the floor with knees bent
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor
Pause without relaxing
Press to full lockout

name: Dumbbell squeeze press
cues: Press the dumbbells together the whole set
Keep your elbows close to your ribs
Lower to your mid chest
Press up without losing the squeeze

name: Dumbbell fly
cues: Soft bend in your elbows that stays fixed
Open your arms wide until you feel a chest stretch
Bring the dumbbells together in a hugging arc
Use a lighter weight than you press

name: Incline dumbbell fly
cues: Set the bench to a low incline
Keep a soft bend in your elbows
Lower in a wide arc to chest level
Squeeze the dumbbells back over your upper chest

name: Dumbbell pullover
cues: Lie across or along the bench holding one dumbbell with both hands
Keep a slight bend in your elbows
Lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch
Pull it back over your chest with your lats

name: Arnold press
cues: Start with palms facing you at chest height
Rotate your palms forward as you press up
Reverse the turn as you lower
Keep your ribs down and your back neutral

name: Single-arm dumbbell shoulder press
cues: Hold the dumbbell at your shoulder
Brace your trunk and stay upright
Press straight up beside your ear
Lower to your shoulder and repeat on both sides

name: Dumbbell push press
cues: Start with the dumbbells on your shoulders
Dip your knees slightly and drive up
Press overhead as your legs extend
Lower to your shoulders under control

name: Dumbbell front raise
cues: Stand tall with the dumbbells in front of your thighs
Raise one or both arms to shoulder height
Keep a soft bend in your elbows
Lower slowly without swinging

name: Dumbbell rear delt raise
cues: Hinge forward with a flat back and arms hanging
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides
Lead with your elbows
Pause at the top and lower slowly

name: Dumbbell upright row
cues: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs
Lift your elbows up and out, leading with them
Stop around chest height
Stop short of any shoulder pinch

name: Dumbbell shrug
cues: Hold the dumbbells at your sides with arms straight
Lift your shoulders straight up
Pause briefly at the top
Lower without rolling your shoulders

name: One-arm dumbbell row
cues: Support yourself with one hand and a knee on the bench
Keep your back flat and hips square
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip
Lower until your arm is straight

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
cues: Lie face down on an incline bench
Let your arms hang straight down
Row the dumbbells toward your ribs
Pause with your shoulder blades squeezed

name: Dumbbell bent-over row
cues: Hinge until your torso is near parallel
Keep your back flat and neck neutral
Row both dumbbells to your lower ribs
Lower with control

name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Hold the dumbbells in front of your thighs
Soft knees, push your hips back
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs
Stand up by driving your hips forward

name: Single-leg dumbbell Romanian deadlift
cues: Hold a dumbbell in the hand opposite your standing leg
Hinge and let your back leg extend behind you
Keep your hips level to the floor
Return upright without twisting

name: Dumbbell goblet squat
cues: Hold one dumbbell upright against your chest
Elbows point down between your knees
Sit deep while keeping your chest up
Stand by driving through your whole foot

name: Dumbbell walking lunge
cues: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides
Step forward and lower your back knee
Keep your torso upright
Push off the front foot into the next step

name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
cues: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides
Step back and lower your back knee toward the floor
Keep your front heel down
Push through your front foot to return

name: Dumbbell split squat
cues: Set a long split stance and keep it fixed
Lower straight down
Keep your front knee tracking over your toes
Drive up without shifting your feet

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
cues: Rest your back foot on a bench
Choose a balanced stance and keep your front knee tracking over your toes
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel
Drive through the front foot to stand

name: Dumbbell step-up
cues: Place your whole front foot on the box
Stand tall by pushing through that heel
Do not push off the back foot
Lower under control

name: Dumbbell lateral lunge
cues: Step wide to one side with toes forward
Sit back into the stepping hip
Keep your other leg straight
Push back to the start

name: Dumbbell sumo squat
cues: Stand wide with toes turned out
Hold one dumbbell between your legs
Lower with your knees tracking over your toes
Squeeze your glutes as you stand

name: Dumbbell hip thrust
cues: Rest your upper back on a bench
Hold the dumbbell across your hips
Drive your hips up until your torso is level
Lower slowly without arching your lower back

name: Dumbbell standing calf raise
cues: Hold the dumbbells at your sides
Rise onto the balls of your feet
Pause at the top
Lower to a full stretch

name: Seated dumbbell calf raise
cues: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs near your knees
Keep the balls of your feet on a raised edge
Raise your heels as high as you can
Lower to a full stretch

name: Dumbbell hammer curl
cues: Hold the dumbbells with palms facing each other
Keep your elbows at your sides
Curl without swinging
Do not rock your torso for momentum

name: Incline dumbbell curl
cues: Sit back on an incline bench with arms hanging
Keep your upper arms still behind your torso
Curl up and squeeze
Lower to a full stretch

name: Concentration curl
cues: Sit and brace your elbow against your inner thigh
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly to a full stretch

name: One-arm dumbbell preacher curl
cues: Sit at a preacher bench and rest your upper arm on the pad
Curl the dumbbell up without lifting your elbow
Pause at the top
Lower until your arm is nearly straight

name: Zottman curl
cues: Curl up with palms facing up
Rotate your palms to face down at the top
Lower slowly with an overhand grip
Rotate back at the bottom

name: Dumbbell reverse curl
cues: Hold the dumbbells overhand
Keep your wrists straight
Curl up with your elbows at your sides
Use lighter dumbbells than for a regular curl

name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
cues: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands
Keep your elbows pointing forward
Lower behind your head until you feel a stretch
Extend back to straight arms

name: Dumbbell triceps kickback
cues: Hinge forward with your upper arm parallel to your torso
Extend your elbow until your arm is straight
Hold your upper arm still
Keep your back flat and your neck neutral

name: Dumbbell skull crusher
cues: Lie on a bench with the dumbbells over your chest
Keep your upper arms still
Bend at the elbows to lower beside your head
Extend back up

name: Dumbbell wrist curl
cues: Rest your forearm on a bench with your palm up
Let the dumbbell roll to your fingertips
Curl your wrist up
Choose a load you can control through the full range

name: Dumbbell reverse wrist curl
cues: Rest your forearm on a bench with your palm down
Lower your wrist as far as is comfortable
Lift the back of your hand up
Use a light weight

name: Dumbbell side bend
cues: Hold one dumbbell at your side
Bend sideways without twisting
Return to upright with your side muscles
Keep the movement slow
